newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Metra Jan-Apr seen in wide range.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Metra Jan-Apr seen in wide range.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed an 83 million markka median forecast for Finnish diversified engineering group Metra Oy Ab's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 13 analysts, EPS by eight analysts).
Metra's four-month results are due on June 11 at 0830/0530 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Metra posted a profit before extraordinaries and tax of 50 million markka.
In February, Metra said it expected earnings to improve slightly this year compared to 1996.
The median of nine analysts' forecasts for Metra's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 775 million markka (mean 805 million) in a 719-1,040 million markka range.
In 1996, Metra's profit was 894 million markka.

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FSB Securities Handelsbanken, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
